headline: New Electric SUV Features Dedicated 'Spouse Argument' Noise-Canceling Mode
body:
The automotive manufacturer launched its latest electric SUV, the BE 6 SPORTEQ, this week, introducing an industry-first 'Domestic Harmony' setting that utilizes external microphones to phase-cancel the specific frequency of a passenger explaining how the driver took the wrong turn at a flyover.

'We spent three years in the laboratory studying the exact pitch of marital frustration,' said a senior product engineer at the company’s R&D center in Chennai. 'The system detects the keywords "always," "listen," and "I told you so," and instantly reroutes the audio output to a soothing loop of lo-fi beats and simulated rain sounds.'

While critics have questioned the utility of the feature, early testers claim the vehicle’s ability to remain serenely quiet during intense navigation debates is worth every rupee of the Rs 19.45 lakh starting price. The car also features an optional 'Aggressive Tailgating Warning' that plays a pre-recorded audio clip of a disappointed grandfather sighing loudly.

Future software updates are expected to include a 'Teenage Music Filter' which automatically lowers the bass when the car senses the driver’s blood pressure rising above 140 bpm. Dealerships have already reported a surge in test drives from husbands seeking a peaceful commute.
caption: The new BE 6 SPORTEQ is here to save your sanity, one argument at a time. Finally, a car that ignores your family as much as you do. #Mahindra #EV #CarTech #DrivingPeace (satire)
